$$\operatorname{tg}\,120^\circ=\operatorname{tg}\left(180^\circ-60^\circ\right)=-\operatorname{tg}\,60^\circ=-\sqrt{3}$$

$$\operatorname{ctg}\left(90^\circ+\alpha\right)=-\operatorname{tg}\alpha$$

$$\cos\,\frac{4\pi}{3}=\cos\,240^\circ=\cos\left(180^\circ+60^\circ\right)=-\cos\,60^\circ=-\frac{1}{2}$$

$$\cos\,\frac{4\pi}{3}=\cos\,240^\circ=\cos\left(180^\circ+60^\circ\right)=-\cos\,60^\circ=-\frac{1}{2}$$

kaa.solution_md:

$$\cos\,\frac{4\pi}{3}=\cos\,240^\circ=\cos\left(180^\circ+60^\circ\right)=-\cos\,60^\circ=-\frac{1}{2}$$
kaa.mistake_note_md: Tipik qátelik: Belgini yamasa funkciya atın almastırıwdı umıtıw ($\sin 150^\circ$ di $-\dfrac12$ dep jazıw sıyaqlı).

en.solution_md:
Reduction rule: at $90^\circ$ and $270^\circ$ the function name changes, at $180^\circ$ and $360^\circ$ it stays; the sign is that of the original function in that quadrant.

$$\cos\,\frac{4\pi}{3}=\cos\,240^\circ=\cos\left(180^\circ+60^\circ\right)=-\cos\,60^\circ=-\frac{1}{2}$$
en.mistake_note_md: Typical mistake: Forgetting the sign or the change of function name (e.g. taking $\sin 150^\circ=-\dfrac12$).

kaa.solution_md: Múyeshlerdi dáwir ($360^{\circ}$ yamasa $180^{\circ}$) hám keltiriw formulaları menen ápiwayılastıramız: $\sin510^{\circ}=\frac{1}{2},\ \cos1200^{\circ}=-\frac{1}{2},\ \operatorname{tg}765^{\circ}=1$. Qosındı $-1$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Shirekke qarap belgini shatastırıw; $360^{\circ}$ tıń pútin eselerin taslamaw.

en.solution_md: Reduce the angles with the period ($360^{\circ}$ or $180^{\circ}$) and reduction formulas: $\sin510^{\circ}=\frac{1}{2},\ \cos1200^{\circ}=-\frac{1}{2},\ \operatorname{tg}765^{\circ}=1$. The sum is $-1$.
en.mistake_note_md: Getting the sign wrong for the quadrant; not discarding whole multiples of $360^{\circ}$.
